scope: Finite protocol scheduling proof only; no hardware timing, native Start, authority or remote retirement evidence
coverage_and_assumptions: Exactly two original scoped Fore sessions, with actual source/sink roles and real wire-machine Hello/Ready validation.
Arbitrary interleaving of Root and MCU control actions; FIFO ordering preserved in both directions; no application payloads during bootstrap.
A send queues a complete framed control message; a receive removes one. Atomic queuing overapproximates unread FIFO bytes because partial physical or framed reads can drain additional bytes.
MCU uses existing Hello/Ready send priority before receive, modeled after its separate genuine StartedEvidence activation gate. This test creates no StartedEvidence.
Sequential Root receives and remembers future-session Hello without replying until the prior session is active. It must not block the receive loop waiting only for one session.
After prior session becomes active, at most its unread42-byte Root Ready can precede the next84-byte Hello/Ready pair; therefore pending <=126 bytes.
Every reachable sequential prefix is locally cancellable without advancing machine state. Cancellation or deadline never asserts peer termination, releases remote custody, or authorizes retry.
64-step proof ceiling is a finite-state exploration guard, not a wall-time model. Existing production10-second handshake budget is unchanged.
No scheduling duration, UART arrival timing, electrical behavior, packet corruption, or fairness under permanent task starvation is proved.
